title: A Criterion for Covariance in Complex Sequential Growth Models
version: arXiv:2003.11311v1; CQG 2020 doi 10.1088/1361-6382/ab987f (publisher text not compared)
section_locator: Abstract; Sec. 1; Sec. 2 (nesting property; 'no event alpha in Z can be covariant unless alpha=Omega'; Eq. (4) covariant set); Theorem 2.1; Sec. 3.3 Eqs. (60)-(62); Sec. 4
relevance: Clauses (a),(b),(c1) of the dilemma, with the authors' own temporality framing in the abstract.
assumptions: C-valued vector measure on finite-stage labelled algebra Z; covariance = relabelling invariance of infinite labelled causets.
conclusion: Established: Z contains no nontrivial covariant event; extension to S_Z iff bounded variation; CP extends only for q in [0,1]. Authors' claim (abstract): covariant observables measurable only if the quantum measure extends, 'because of the temporality of the growth process'.
proof_status: Proofs in paper; Theorem 2.1 proof in App. B (not re-audited this run).
limits: Re-read Abstract, Secs. 1, 2, 4 in this run via fetch-tool fragments; full-text read recorded in knowledge/csg-quantum. No ontology discussion.
